mechanism: Negotiation concession. When `{{overlap}}` fails: 1. Agents declare 'Flex' (concession) and 'Weight' (importance). 2. {{system}} computes Yield-Ratio. 3. Lower-weighted preference cedes to higher. 4. Debt recorded in the {{ledger}}. Utilizes {{defer}}.
gloss: Weighted negotiation concession with deferred debt ledger
failure_modes: Weight inflation: a party overstates importance to win the ratio.
Hard constraints genuinely indistinguishable from strategic intransigence.
invariants: Both sides declare Flex and Weight before the Yield-Ratio is computed.
The lower-weighted preference cedes to the higher.
Every concession is recorded as debt in the {{ledger}}.
The concession is final for this negotiation; reciprocity runs through the {{ledger}}, not retraction.
preconditions: A durable {{ledger}} is available to record the debt
